name: The Bell That Ends the Curse

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one ordinary magical Condition and one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn. No injury or Specialty Condition is removed.

surges.html: Extend only the Wound suppression through the end of your next turn.
The target reduces its next incoming magical Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: bind the target. Trigger: the source of the suppressed ordinary Condition targets it with an Action. Echo: grant +1 to the targeted Defense against that Action.
